Who We Are

Pioneering Nigeria's
Agricultural Future.

Since 1991, Agrited has been at the forefront of the Nigerian poultry industry. We don't just supply day-old chicks; we engineer agricultural success. By integrating world-class genetics with state-of-the-art facility design, we empower farmers to achieve unprecedented yield and sustainability.
